answer_1.quote: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have propelled significant progress in machine translation.

answer_2.quote: Translation quality is mainly measured using two metrics: COMET-22, a neural metric trained on human preferences to assess semantic adequacy and fluency; and BLEURT-20, a reference-based metric optimized for low-resource languages.

answer_3.quote: Lacking human-annotated reference translations, we employed GPT-4 to evaluate the quality of the model-generated x2x translations.
